in_sanskrit.name: Gaddam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain Fortress
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gaddam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Gaddam is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Gadha’ which means ‘Mountain’ and ‘Dam’ which means ‘Fortress’. This name signifies a strong and resilient individual, much like a fortress on a mountain.
